prompts.invaders: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original cinematic background for a premium browser arcade game, Agency Invaders. Create one single 16:9 landscape image, ideally 1920 by 1080 pixels. Scene: a vast orbital field above a magnificent gas giant, luminous nebula haze and a distant intricate orbital station with silver metallic trusses and subtle warm orange practical lights. The gas giant is centered in the upper third so its curved horizon survives a center portrait crop. Make the station and nebula read as multiple planes of atmospheric depth, not flat icons. Style: polished high-end realistic 3D science-fiction environment concept art, physically plausible materials, smooth volumetric light, restrained cinematic bloom, rich atmospheric perspective, beautiful resolved details. Palette: deep navy and charcoal, cool silver, restrained warm HTSG orange accents; mature and elegant, not rainbow neon. Composition: central 55 percent remains coherent when cropped to a tall phone; broad middle and lower half are dark, uncluttered open space for moving game objects, while the upper third carries the epic scene. Subtle starfield with natural density variation and soft dust. No foreground game ships, no people, no creatures, no characters, no weapons firing, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no interface, no panels or HUD. Avoid pixel art, vector illustration, flat geometry, low-poly style, stock-photo collage and busy high-contrast noise. Opaque full-bleed image.
prompts.runner: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original cinematic background for a premium browser arcade game, Launch Runner. Create one single 16:9 landscape image, ideally 1920 by 1080 pixels. Scene: a futuristic launch complex and sophisticated alien city at dusk, viewed from a low side-on perspective across an expansive launch deck. A dramatic launch tower near the central upper third, elegant distant towers, layered elevated architecture and hazy mountains establish impressive depth. A huge soft orbital planet or crescent can appear in the upper sky, consistent with a carefully art-directed science-fiction world. Style: polished high-end realistic 3D environment concept art with physically plausible brushed silver structures, smooth volumetric twilight, restrained orange launch lighting and cinematic atmospheric perspective. Palette: deep navy and charcoal, cool silver, warm HTSG orange sunset accents; mature and elegant, not rainbow neon. Composition: the skyline sits mainly in the upper half, a horizon around 55 percent height, with the bottom quarter a quiet shadowed launch-deck atmosphere for a separate game track and moving foreground obstacles. Central 55 percent remains coherent in a tall phone center crop. Convey large scale and multiple receding planes, not flat icons. No vehicles or runners in the foreground, no people, no creatures, no game characters, no explosion, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no HUD. Avoid pixel art, vector illustration, flat geometry, low-poly style and overly busy fine noise. Opaque full-bleed image.
prompts.trivia: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original cinematic background for a premium browser Trivia Challenge. Create one single 16:9 landscape image, ideally 1920 by 1080 pixels. Scene: a sophisticated orbital observatory, with a panoramic curved window revealing a distant planet and gentle nebula light. Graceful architectural ribs and a few subtle luminous orbital-science arcs at the periphery give the impression of a refined holographic science environment. An empty polished research deck, cool silver structure, soft reflected light and a long view beyond the glass convey believable depth. Style: high-end smooth realistic 3D science-fiction environment render, atmospheric perspective, physically plausible materials, restrained bloom, refined cinematic detail. Palette: deep navy and charcoal, silver, muted cool light with small warm HTSG orange accents; mature, cohesive and elegant rather than rainbow neon. Composition: broad dark quiet negative space through the central 60 percent for readable quiz content; all brighter architectural and orbital accents are peripheral or in the upper third. Keep the central planet/window view meaningful in a tall phone center crop. No people, no creatures, no robots, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no interface panels, no buttons, no charts, no HUD. The holographic arcs must be abstract light geometry without glyphs. Avoid pixel art, vector illustration, flat geometry, low-poly style, clutter and dense high-contrast noise. Opaque full-bleed image.
